title.en: OpenAI 401 and 429 Errors: Practical Fix Checklist
title.zh: OpenAI 401 与 429 报错排查清单

excerpt.en: Diagnose unauthorized and rate/quota errors quickly with a production-ready checklist based on official OpenAI guidance.
excerpt.zh: 基于 OpenAI 官方文档，快速定位 Unauthorized 与限流/额度类报错，并给出可落地处理步骤。

heading.en: 1) 401 errors: split auth vs policy causes
heading.zh: 1）401：先区分认证问题还是策略问题

en: OpenAI error guidance lists multiple 401 scenarios, including invalid credentials and IP allowlist mismatch. Treat 401 as a category, not a single root cause. If you're starting from scratch, [[guide:how-to-get-openai-api-key|getting your OpenAI API key]] correctly from the start prevents most 401 issues.

Start by checking which key is used, which project it belongs to, and whether your request source IP matches project policy. For [[guide:openai-api-key-setup-2026|proper key configuration]] including permission scoping and project assignment, see our setup guide.
zh: OpenAI 错误文档中，401 不止一种原因，包括认证失败与 IP 白名单不匹配等。不要把 401 当成单一问题。如果从头开始，[[guide:how-to-get-openai-api-key|正确获取 OpenAI API Key]] 可以避免大部分 401 问题。
建议先确认：当前使用的是哪把 Key、归属哪个项目、请求出口 IP 是否符合项目策略。关于[[guide:openai-api-key-setup-2026|正确配置密钥]]，包括权限范围和项目分配，请参阅我们的设置指南。

en: Confirm key belongs to the expected organization/project
zh: 确认 Key 归属组织/项目是否正确
检查 IP 白名单配置

en: OpenAI distinguishes at least two common 429 patterns: rate-limit reached and current quota exceeded. The mitigation path is different for each.

If requests are too fast, smooth traffic and retry with backoff. If quota is exceeded, check billing, limits, and project budget settings. [[guide:openai-api-pricing|Understanding your quota and spending limits]] helps you distinguish billing issues from traffic spikes.
zh: OpenAI 常见的 429 包括“请求频率过快”和“额度/预算已用尽”，两者处理路径不同。
前者要做流量平滑与重试，后者要优先检查计费、limits 和项目预算。[[guide:openai-api-pricing|了解你的额度和消费限制]] 有助于区分计费问题和流量突发。

en: OpenAI rate limits are measured across several dimensions. You can hit RPM first even when TPM still looks healthy, so monitor both request and token dimensions. [[guide:openai-api-key-complete-guide|The full OpenAI API reference]] documents these limits for each tier and model.
Unsuccessful requests still count toward per-minute limits, so repeated immediate retries can worsen incidents.
zh: OpenAI 限额是多维度的，可能先撞到 RPM，即使 TPM 还没满，因此要同时看请求和 token 两个维度。[[guide:openai-api-key-complete-guide|完整的 OpenAI API 参考指南]] 记录了每个等级和模型的限额。
官方文档也强调：失败请求同样计入限额，盲目立刻重试会让问题更严重。

en: Use exponential backoff with jitter for retriable failures. Pair retries with request deduplication and timeout budgets to prevent retry storms.
Also tune max_tokens close to expected output size, because rate-limit accounting can depend on max_tokens estimates.
zh: 对可重试错误使用带抖动的指数退避，并结合去重与超时预算，防止形成重试风暴。
同时把 max_tokens 调整到接近真实输出规模，因为限流计算会参考 max_tokens 的估算影响。

en: For recurring 401/429 incidents, create a runbook with ownership, alert thresholds, rollback paths, and communication templates.
A short, repeatable checklist is usually more valuable than ad-hoc debugging during peak traffic.
zh: 如果 401/429 问题反复出现，建议沉淀 Runbook：责任人、告警阈值、回滚方案、对外沟通模板。
在高峰期，标准化的短流程比临时排查更能保证恢复速度。

heading.en: Real Debugging Session: A 429 That Wasn't Rate Limit
heading.zh: 真实调试案例：一个不是速率限制的 429

en: We once spent two hours chasing a persistent 429 error that turned out to be something entirely different. Here's what happened:

Our application started returning 429 on every request after a deployment. We assumed rate limiting and implemented aggressive backoff — but the errors continued even after 10 minutes of zero traffic. That was the clue: true rate limits reset within 60 seconds.

The actual cause: our new deployment had a bug where the API key environment variable was empty in one container. OpenAI returned 429 (not 401) because the empty key triggered a different internal path. The fix was a one-line config correction.
Lesson: if 429 persists beyond 60 seconds of zero traffic, it's not a rate limit. Check your key, your headers, and your deployment configuration.
zh: 我们曾花了两小时追查一个持续的 429 错误，结果发现原因完全不同。事情是这样的：
我们的应用在一次部署后每个请求都返回 429。我们以为是速率限制，实施了激进退避 —— 但即使零流量 10 分钟后错误仍在继续。这就是线索：真正的速率限制在 60 秒内会重置。
实际原因：我们的新部署有一个 bug，一个容器里的 API Key 环境变量为空。OpenAI 返回了 429（而非 401），因为空 Key 触发了不同的内部路径。修复只需改一行配置。
教训：如果 429 在零流量超过 60 秒后仍然存在，那就不是速率限制。检查你的 Key、请求头和部署配置。

question.en: Why does 429 happen even when token usage seems low?
question.zh: 为什么 token 看起来不高也会出现 429？

answer.en: You may be hitting RPM before TPM, or frequent failed retries may already consume your per-minute quota.
answer.zh: 可能是 RPM 先触顶，或失败重试过多导致每分钟配额被提前耗尽。

question.en: How can I distinguish quota issues from rate spikes?
question.zh: 如何区分额度问题和瞬时限流？

answer.en: Check the exact error message: 'rate limit reached' usually indicates traffic pacing issues, while 'current quota exceeded' points to billing/limits.
answer.zh: 看错误文案最直接：'rate limit reached' 多为请求节奏问题，'current quota exceeded' 多与计费或额度上限有关。

question.en: Should I keep retrying aggressively after a 429?
question.zh: 出现 429 后要不要高频重试？

answer.en: No. Use controlled backoff with jitter and reduce request burstiness first.
answer.zh: 不建议。应先做退避重试并降低突发请求强度。
